inc-bot: ALERT: SLO burn detected: /v1/generate 5xx+timeouts > 2% over 15m (region: us-west-2). Alert id: A-20260315001 :rotating_light:

DANA: seeing a spike in 5xx/timeouts in hosted inference, customers reporting increased latency and errors. CS flagged two enterprise tenants. :frowning:

MARCO: copying Grafana panel — looks like p50 jumped, but error rate spike is primarily timeouts (gateway 504). traces show a lot of requests with no spans after ingress.

ALEX: @marco can you paste the query you used? I want to check backend pool metrics.

MARCO: sure. LogQL I ran on loki:
```
sum by (route) (rate({app="api-gateway", http_status=~"5.."} |= "timeout"[5m]))
```
Filter for /v1/generate gives: spike centered at 1783005600-1783005800.

DANA: CS says they attempted retries and saw consistent 504s. No auth errors. Billing looks unaffected.

ELI-CS: Confirmed from support tickets: request id 0a1b2c from tenant acme-inc at 12:02 UTC got 504, then 502 on retry.

JADE: I checked pool saturation on dedicated-serving: GPU util and qps fine. But gateway pods show elevated connection resets to runtime.

ALEX: could be proxy/keepalive or idle connection culling between gateway and runtime. Any recent deploys?

MARCO: No deploys in last 2 hours according to deploy-bot. But we had a config roll earlier today for nginx upstream timeout change (PR #776). Rolling that back might help.

DANA: can we reproduce quickly? I'll run curl against internal gateway with large prompt to exceed KV cache init and induce longer runtime processing.

ALEX: repro curl:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-xl","input":"'$(python -c 'print("x"*20000)')'"}' https://gateway.internal/v1/generate | jq .
```
I see connection reset after ~15s locally.

MARCO: looking at gateway logs: many "upstream prematurely closed connection" errors. runtime logs show no corresponding long-running request traces — suggests requests never reached runtime or were dropped before span emission.

ELI-CS: CS: tenants reported timeouts across regions but majority in us-west-2 and us-east-1.

JADE: tracing gap — we rely on sidecar to emit spans. If sidecar restarts or OOMs it might not forward. Check sidecar restarts: kube events show ephemeral restarts on gateway sidecar in last 20m.

ALEX: that's promising. Which container? envoy-sidecar v1.14. Crash logs show TLS handshake failure to runtime on new connections: "handshake: EOF" repeatedly. Could be cert rotation issue.

DANA: cert rotation? There was a short-lived rotation job earlier for inter-service certs. Maybe not fully rolled out.

MARCO: quick mitigation: enable fallback routing to dedicated-backend-v1 (older certs) for 30m and increase gateway timeouts to 45s. I'll create a canary route.

JADE: ack. I'll patch the gateway upstream config:
```yaml
spec:
  timeouts:
    request: 45s
  routing:
    fallback: dedicated-backend-v1
```
Applying now.

DANA: applied. Monitoring error rate...

inc-bot: ACTION: Route fallback enabled and gateway timeout set to 45s by marco.

MARCO: post-change metrics: error rate dropped from 2.4% -> 0.6% in 5m window. P50 latency back to normal. Traces returning.

ELI-CS: CS confirmed reduced tickets and customer responses look positive.

ALEX: root cause hypothesis: cert rotation introduced intermittent TLS handshake failures in sidecar, causing upstream closes and missing spans. Two follow-ups: 1) revert bad cert or complete rollout, 2) add dashboard tile for sidecar TLS handshake errors + alert threshold.

DANA: Agreed. Also short-term: update runbook to include fallback route and timeout bump for gateway when "upstream prematurely closed connection" >= 5 per min.

MARCO: I'll open PR for runbook and add a LogQL saved query and Tempo dashboard panel.

JADE: For detection coverage: we should alert not only on 5xx rate but also on span emission rate drop (traces emitted/s). Add a composite alert: error rate OR trace emission delta > 40% in 10m.

ALEX: adding to backlog. I'll also add a passive check in the release CI for cert rotation job to validate handshake on a staging cluster before rolling prod.

ELI-CS: final ask from CS: notify affected tenants with status update and ETA. I'll draft a message once we confirm cert fix.

DANA: great. Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring for 60m and then close this thread. :thumbsup:
